create_flash_causal_lm_batch: create a FlashCausalLMBatch from protobuf batch requests using the from_pb class method with a tokenizer
generate_token_from_batch: run the FlashCausalLM generate_token method to produce the next tokens for a prefill or decode batch
filter_flash_causal_lm_batch: filter a FlashCausalLMBatch to keep only specific request IDs and rebuild tensors and block tables
concatenate_flash_causal_lm_batches: concatenate multiple FlashCausalLMBatch instances into a single batch merging requests tensors and block tables
warmup_flash_causal_lm: run the FlashCausalLM warmup method to initialize KV cache CUDA graphs and TunableOp for a target model
